QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Student From Another World
QuestInfo.0: Someone is calling you. They don't sound like they're from around here.
QuestInfo.1: This unusual device is called a smartphone. Go to the [Closet House] in Henesys to meet the student from another world.\r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Ask Elwin how a person from another world got here.
